findings.explanation: Client has 90 days to pay your invoices, which significantly delays your cash flow.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am eager to move forward, and I would like to request one small adjustment before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms allow 90 days for payment which significantly delays cash flow, so I propose updating the agreement so that invoices are payable Net 30. Thank you for your understanding. Best regards,
